title: From the Regent of Fanged Fury
From Wrothgar to Lilmoth: A Smith's Tale, Vol 1

claim_seeds.evidence_preview: I'm just an old Orc weaponsmith, and weapons are my life.
When I was just a nub-tusked whelp, I would sneak into the great forges of Orsinium to watch the masters at work.
In time I became an apprentice, dragging slag from one end of the forge to the other.
I don't mind admitting that I was dead wrong.
These Argonians use methods and materials that I never could have imagined, and the results are extraordinary.
